title: Finite bit construction: five-wire prefixes save 340 further ADDs beyond PR904 (no new kappa)
body:
The frozen PR904 R439 word still contains phase-A windows that admit shorter five-wire circuits. This finite construction selects **88 disjoint replacements**, saving **170 A ADDs plus 170 literal reverse-cleanup ADDs**: **24,051 → 23,711** complete local ADDs. Relative to selected PR589, the total saving is **594 ADDs**, including PR904's credited 254. **No new kappa is claimed.**

All original helpers, every register's ordered MOVE path, all COPY/ERASE records, nine rank-seven totals, H1–H5, decoder constant 63 and paid rank mass 5,129 are preserved. The positive forward/reverse bounds improve from **43,671 / 928,888** to **41,311 / 843,188**; local payload remains 92 bits. The full 5/9/11-stage ADD savings are **1,700 / 3,060 / 3,740**, with unchanged paid bridges and copies.

Reproduce with Python 3.11+, C++17 and Boost headers:

```sh
BOOST_INCLUDE=/path/to/boost-headers python3 -I -B research/r439-five-wire-prefix/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R439_FIVE_WIRE_PREFIX: 88 rewrites; 340 further ADDs saved; H1-H5; 5/9/11 stages; 17 controls; no new kappa`.

The full package replay passes on CPython 3.14.6, both normally and with an optimized isolated driver. It regenerates every decoded candidate/certificate field; a separately implemented checker evaluates **2,816 Boolean inputs** and **880 positive unit-column pairs**. The unchanged source checker passes both complete words on **661 symbolic columns** with all interface hypotheses/conclusions. Fresh unchanged C++ legality and 5/9/11-stage checks pass on **883 / 1,327 / 1,549 columns per word**. All **17 local controls** and **96 omitted-bridge controls** pass. Source pins match 19 exact Git objects; selected-record and staged whitespace checks pass. Full repository suites, hosted repricing, outer assembly, and formal verification of the multiplication theorem are not claimed. Hosted CI is separate.

The bounded seed-10 search completes all **1,805 exactly-five-wire phase-A windows** (maximum allowed length 12; observed maximum 11), comprising 1,097 maps. Depth-three balls with one first BFS path per state produce candidates of length at most six. There are 509 windows with shorter nominees and 461 passing both positive guards; weighted interval selection chooses 88. It is one completed scan, not an exhaustive search over all representatives, a fixed point, or an optimality claim. As a same-input comparison, a second unchanged PR904 four-wire pass saves **84** complete ADDs. Those 84 and our 340 are alternative passes, not additive savings; no four-wire saturation claim or intrinsic need for five wires is made.

**Provenance:** OS seed **10**, bit-supplier track. Initial base **91a2094f2e022930069e8cfdc810a3ea1b81cd09**, rebased onto **47481c89fd30a43f8f882eb4b391e89c29273fd0** after the eighteen-PR integration. All 12 upstream source/checker pins were unchanged. PR904 is pinned at **883a0bdf7792693e57c16be660824b57aacfbe05**, with its candidate, certificate, comparison code and notices retained. Only `research/r439-five-wire-prefix/` is added. There was no pinned sprint issue; the claim is local. The final overlap refresh covers PR933's paid-moment transport/reframing work, which has a different objective and input. Other block and compensation savings are not composed here.

Maintainers advanced the accepted frontier during this session to **0.001661957774647029 (PR890)**, retaining PR589's bit supplier. This package changes no selected frontier. Its paid bit profile/moment remains unchanged; all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source, whole-call hosting, precision/tape and analytic assumptions remain, as does later integration into the full hosted emitter/invoice if adopted.

Credit **Gareth Davidson (@bitplane), PR904**, and **Jeffrey Cox (@namredips), PR754**, for the predecessor resynthesis/positive-guard/interval method; **DreamingOfClouds PR589**, **eumemic PR555/543** and the retained ancestry; **Sagar Thakrar**, **Dylan Crow**, **DaysSky**, **Zhihao Chen** and their native verification notices. Prepared by **Ross Richardson (@RossRichardson)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including a separately tasked AI checker. No independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0; predecessor notices preserved.

Published head: **0679fb6e1e4c91f573ae07ab1d0ea273b13c74e3**. Mathematical implementation: **214488bb15e70c94ba7316c923fd8afc7208b499**; the final commit only records the completed local claim and PR link. Remote OPEN state, matching commit, 21-file scope and clean worktree were verified. All five hosted workflows at this head report **`action_required`**; no hosted CI pass is claimed. [Research-artifact workflow](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38406699798). A post-submission check also found PR935's complex U8/full-center cleanup construction, outside this bit phase-A scope.
